steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Esperanza Spalding is a bassist-vocalist-composer — her music fuses jazz, funk, Brazilian and classical traditions, exemplifying contemporary fusion. | Key Fact: I Know You Know features a catchy jazz-pop melody with sophisticated harmony, bass-driven groove and vocal-bass interplay. | Key Fact: Little Fly sets a poem by William Blake to music — the word painting (music illustrating text meaning) demonstrates sophisticated compositional technique. | Key Fact: I Adore You combines Brazilian-influenced rhythm with jazz harmony and pop accessibility — it demonstrates Spalding's genre-crossing approach.
